name: threadline-stylist
onCreateCommand:
set -e
marker="${PROMPTSTER_HOSTED_SETUP_MARKER:-$HOME/.promptster/hosted-setup-complete}"
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$marker")"
rm -f "$marker" "$marker.tmp"
started_at="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
started_epoch="$(date -u +%s)"
# Arm the fork guard (openspec 0.1a). Versioned hooks need core.hooksPath;
# .git/hooks is not part of the tree.
git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
(
python3 -m venv .venv
  .venv/bin/pip install -q --upgrade pip
  .venv/bin/pip install -q -e ".[dev]"
)
completed_at="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
completed_epoch="$(date -u +%s)"
{
  echo "schema=1"
  echo "startedAt=$started_at"
  echo "completedAt=$completed_at"
  echo "setupSeconds=$((completed_epoch - started_epoch))"
  echo "prebuildEnvRaw=${CODESPACE_PREBUILD-}"
  echo "prebuildEnvSet=$(if [ -n "${CODESPACE_PREBUILD+x}" ]; then echo yes; else echo no; fi)"
  echo "codespaceName=${CODESPACE_NAME-}"
  echo "issueId=${PROMPTSTER_ISSUE_ID-}"
} > "$marker.tmp"
mv -f "$marker.tmp" "$marker"
